description: Structured eval definitions for the Glue Crawler Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Glue Crawler scenarios (S3 crawler with custom JSON classifier and partition projection, DynamoDB export crawl, JDBC crawler with Glue Connection, Lake Formation event-driven crawl, missing IAM role prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: S3 crawler with custom JSON classifier and partition projection
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — S3 crawler with EventsJsonClassifier listed before built-in JSON, partition projection for year/month/day, incremental crawl, daily cron
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Glue Crawler for S3 data at s3://my-data-lake/events/year=2026/. Data is JSON files with nested event_id, timestamp, event_type, and payload fields. Create a custom JSON classifier named EventsJsonClassifier. Use partition projection for year, month, and day columns. Database analytics_db. Incremental crawl. Daily schedule at 2 AM UTC. Table prefix raw_. Tags: Environment=production, DataSource=s3-events.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GLUE_CRAWLER: events-crawler (S3: s3://my-data-lake/events/)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Classifiers: ["EventsJsonClassifier"] (first-match-wins)
  [✓] Partitioning: partition-projection (year, month, day)
  [✓] Crawl mode: incremental
  [✓] Schedule: cron(0 2 * * ? *)

eval_cases.name: DynamoDB export to S3 crawl
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — DynamoDB table exported to S3 in DYNAMODB_JSON format, crawler reads from S3 export path
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Glue Crawler for a DynamoDB table exported to S3. The table UserEvents was exported to s3://my-ddb-exports/dynamodb/UserEvents/ in DYNAMODB_JSON format. Database dynamo_db. Full crawl. Weekly schedule. Tags: Environment=production, Source=dynamodb.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GLUE_CRAWLER: ddb-userevents-crawler (S3: s3://my-ddb-exports/dynamodb/UserEvents/)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Data source: DynamoDB-export (s3://my-ddb-exports/dynamodb/UserEvents/)
  [✓] Crawl mode: full

eval_cases.name: JDBC crawler with Glue Connection for PostgreSQL
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — JDBC crawler using pg-connection Glue Connection, public schema, full crawl, on-demand
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Glue Crawler for a PostgreSQL database. Glue Connection name pg-connection. Crawl the public schema. Database jdbc_db. Full crawl. On-demand schedule initially. IAM role GlueJdbcCrawlerRole. Tags: Environment=production, Source=postgresql.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GLUE_CRAWLER: pg-crawler (JDBC: pg-connection)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Data source: JDBC (pg-connection)
  [✓] Crawl mode: full

eval_cases.name: Lake Formation event-driven crawl with Grok classifier
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — LF-enabled database, LF permissions on crawler role, event-driven via S3 Event Notifications, Grok classifier, MergeNewColumns
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Glue Crawler for S3 data at s3://my-data-lake/logs/. The database lf_analytics_db is Lake Formation-enabled. Crawler role GlueLFCrawlerRole needs LF permissions. Event-driven crawl triggered by S3 ObjectCreated events on the logs/ prefix. Custom Grok classifier AppLogClassifier for log parsing. MergeNewColumns schema policy. Tags: Environment=production, Governance=lake-formation.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GLUE_CRAWLER: lf-logs-crawler (S3: s3://my-data-lake/logs/)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Lake Formation: enabled (LF permissions granted)
  [✓] Classifiers: ["AppLogClassifier"] (first-match-wins)
  [✓] Schedule: event-driven (S3 ObjectCreated)

eval_cases.name: Glue Crawler request without IAM role or S3 path (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — operator does not provide IAM role name or S3 data source path
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Glue Crawler for my S3 data. I need it to discover schema and create tables. Daily schedule. Use incremental crawl.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GLUE_CRAWLER: unknown
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] IAM role: not provided — crawler requires an IAM role with glue and s3 permissions
  [✗] Data source: not provided — S3 path is required for the crawler to read
